db:select.doc:name: Select all requests
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, collection_id, name, description, pre_request_json, request_json, post_response_json, input_data_sets_json FROM syskm.requests ORDER BY name

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import * from dw::rowToRequest --- vars.rows map ((r) -> rowToRequest(r))

db:select.doc:name: Select one request
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, collection_id, name, description, pre_request_json, request_json, post_response_json, input_data_sets_json FROM syskm.requests WHERE id = :id

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import * from dw::rowToRequest --- rowToRequest(vars.rows[0])

db:update.doc:name: Upsert request
db:update.db:sql: MERGE INTO syskm.requests t USING (SELECT :id AS id, :collectionId AS collection_id, :name AS name, :description AS description, :preRequest AS pre_request_json, :request AS request_json, :postResponse AS post_response_json, :inputDataSets AS input_data_sets_json FROM DUAL) s ON (t.id = s.id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.collection_id = s.collection_id, t.name = s.name, t.description = s.description, t.pre_request_json = s.pre_request_json, t.request_json = s.request_json, t.post_response_json = s.post_response_json, t.input_data_sets_json = s.input_data_sets_json WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, collection_id, name, description, pre_request_json, request_json, post_response_json, input_data_sets_json) VALUES (s.id, s.collection_id, s.name, s.description, s.pre_request_json, s.request_json, s.post_response_json, s.input_data_sets_json)
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ id: attributes.uriParams.requestId, collectionId: payload.collectionId default null, name: payload.name default "", description: payload.description default "", preRequest: write(payload.preRequest default [], "application/json"), request: write(payload.request default {}, "application/json"), postResponse: write(payload.postResponse default [], "application/json"), inputDataSets: write(payload.inputDataSets default [], "application/json") }]

db:select.doc:name: Select run logs
db:select.db:sql: SELECT run_id, status, result_json, created_at FROM syskm.run_logs WHERE request_id = :id ORDER BY created_at DESC
